about_the_game:
In the future, an explosion at a biotechnology laboratory in a certain city leads to a chemical leak, triggering a spacetime rift. This leak causes a dramatic change in the human world; many people mutate and gain superpowers, becoming special beings known as "Superpowered Individuals." The reason for this emergence lies hidden deep within the spacetime rift, posing an unknown threat to humanity.

Three Core Dungeons, Unlocking Diverse Challenges

Three core dungeons work together to create a three-dimensional adventure battlefield! Adventure dungeons unlock unknown realms, leading you to explore surprises and challenges hidden deep within the map; arena dungeons ignite heated battles, allowing you to dominate the arena and enjoy the thrill and passion of PvP; level dungeons progress in layers, complemented by daily dungeons, the Trial Road, and other unique mini-dungeons, along with numerous meticulously designed smaller levels. Every challenge offers a new experience, rejecting tedious grinding. Even in short bursts of free time, you can easily enjoy the fun and reap generous rewards, steadily increasing your combat power.

Diverse Companions Assemble, Strategic Team Building at Your Fingertips

Dozens of unique companion characters await your command, each possessing exclusive attributes and unique combat abilities. Without fixed team formations, your strategic combinations allow you to build your own battle squad. Whether focusing on burst damage, defensive sustainability, or crowd control, you can create teams suitable for different dungeons and scenarios. Freely combine characters, adapt flexibly, unlock diverse combat gameplay, and experience the joy of strategic gameplay.

Massive Task Rewards, Easy and Stress-Free Development

A wealth of task rewards ensures effortless and stress-free development! A rich and diverse task system includes daily and achievement tasks. Complete simple tasks daily to receive generous rewards, helping characters level up and increase combat power; achieve achievements to unlock exclusive honors and rare items. Every effort is rewarded, allowing even free-to-play players to easily unlock core gameplay and enjoy the game's fun.

Rich and Unique Gameplay, Unlocking a Multi-Dimensional Experience

Diverse and unrestricted gameplay unlocks a multi-dimensional gaming experience! Beyond the core dungeon challenges and character development, there are also unique gameplay features such as power rankings and guild interactions waiting for you to unlock. Focus on developing your character to climb the power rankings, become a server-wide star, and reap exclusive honors and rewards; join a guild to meet like-minded partners, team up to conquer dungeons, fight side-by-side, share guild benefits, and unlock more social and team battle fun, making your adventure less lonely.

content_descriptors.notes: The game does not contain nude characters or any sexual activity. The most explicit content features female characters in bikinis, and includes a large number of adult female characters in bikinis. All characters in the game are 20 years of age or older. Please consider carefully before playing.
